test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The incorrect spelling is: "**Pnemonia"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the correct spelling of the other words.
 
 
• **Pomegranate**:- Name of Fruit.
 
• **Practice**:- Exercise
 
• **Pneumonia**:- Pneumonia is an infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs
 
• **Platter**:- A platter is a large flat dish or plate, typically oval or circular in shape, used for serving a meal or course
 
 
 
• Hence, the incorrectly spelt word is **"Pnemonia" **i.e. option 3.
